name: Batchelor Institute workshop travel, accommodation and meals
provider: Batchelor Institute of Indigenous Tertiary Education
summary: Travel, accommodation and meals covered for Indigenous Batchelor students on ABSTUDY attending study workshops at Batchelor or Alice Springs.
key: Cost of Travel, accommodation and meals are covered for the duration of the workshop.
who: Enrolled in a Batchelor Institute course
Approved for an ABSTUDY benefit (excluding Away From Base assistance)
how: Enrol, then give the Institute written evidence of your ABSTUDY approval; your lecturer submits a Travel Request.
Confirm or cancel before 12pm on the Wednesday before the workshop.
catches: Costs outside approved workshop dates aren't covered.
Children's travel and care are your responsibility.

evidence.quote: Cost of Travel, accommodation and meals are covered for the duration of the workshop.
To be eligible for travel assistance, students are required to be enrolled in a course
